events.title: Marcus Theatres Soars to Best Weekend of All Time
events.summary: Marcus Theatres, a division of Marcus Corporation, announced its highest-grossing weekend in company history, driven by the record-breaking opening of "Spider-Man: Brand New Day," coupled with strong performances from "The Odyssey" and "Toy Story 5." The weekend set new records across multiple categories, including total revenue, box office, concessions, and attendance. This achievement underscores the continued demand for the big-screen theatrical experience, following a year of other record-breaking successes for Marcus Theatres.

events.title: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" Swings to a $19.2 Million IMAX Opening Weekend in China, Setting Franchise-Best Records
events.summary: Sony Pictures/Marvel's "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" achieved a record-breaking $19.2 million IMAX opening weekend in China, marking IMAX's biggest Hollywood opening day in China since "Avengers: Endgame" in 2019. The film accounted for 16% of the nationwide box office on only 1% of screens, demonstrating significant audience demand. This success fuels IMAX China's momentum, with a strong content pipeline including Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey" and other films scheduled for release.

events.title: 'Disney Worldbuilders' Premieres August 20 on Disney+
events.summary: A new feature-length documentary titled "Disney Worldbuilders" will premiere on Disney+ on August 20, featuring interviews with influential Disney storytellers like Bob Iger, James Cameron, and Jon Favreau. The film, directed by Leslie Iwerks, explores how Disney stories are brought to life in theme parks and how creative practices link inspiration between narrative and physical spaces. It also offers a glimpse into upcoming lands at Disney destinations worldwide, highlighting a period of significant creative expansion for the company.

events.title: Spider-Man Sets China IMAX Franchise Record Before Aug. 6 Expansion
events.summary: Sony Pictures' Spider-Man: Brand New Day is expanding its IMAX release across North America starting August 6, following a highly successful opening weekend in China, Japan, and South Korea where it generated $23 million at the IMAX box office. The film achieved the biggest IMAX opening weekend for the Spider-Man franchise in China and set a new record for IMAX opening weekend in South Korea. This expansion aims to capitalize on the film's global success and strong audience reception, with CEO Rich Gelfond noting Spider-Man's consistent bankability and the potential for new and repeat viewings.

events.title: Kraft Heinz and Walt Disney Co. Form Alliance Uniting Iconic Companies Across Food, Media and Experiences
events.summary: Kraft Heinz and The Walt Disney Company have announced a long-term strategic alliance across foodservice, media, and events. This collaboration will integrate ten Kraft Heinz brands into Disney's North American parks, resorts, and cruise lines, introducing new menu offerings and guest experiences. The partnership aims to deliver elevated experiences and storytelling, turning everyday meals into lasting memories for families.

events.title: TKO Group Holdings Q2 2026: Revenue $1.547B, Net Income $303.9M, Adjusted EBITDA $649.9M
events.summary: TKO Group Holdings announced strong Q2 2026 results with revenue of $1.547 billion, net income of $303.9 million, and Adjusted EBITDA of $649.9 million, leading the company to raise its full-year 2026 guidance. events.summary: The Walt Disney Company has appointed Violeta Trincado as Content Sales Supervisor for Iberia. She will be based in Madrid, reporting to Joaquín Becerra and Diana Borbón, as Disney resumes its content distribution and licensing activities.

events.title: ‘Madden’ and ‘Apex Legends’ Publisher Is Now Officially Owned by Saudi Arabia
events.summary: Electronic Arts (EA) has officially been acquired by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jared Kushner’s Affinity Partners, and Silver Lake in an all-cash deal valued at $55 billion. This move further expands the PIF's influence in the video game industry, which it states is for diversifying Saudi Arabia's economy, though critics view it as "sportswashing." The acquisition raises concerns among EA employees and some players about potential impacts on creative content, especially given the PIF's conservative politics and previous influence on game development.

events.title: Disney sets 8:30 a.m. ET webcast after quarterly results post
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company announced it will post its fiscal third-quarter 2026 financial results on August 5, 2026, at approximately 6:30 a.m. ET. Investors can access the earnings materials and webcast through the company's investor relations website.

events.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Sets a New Global Box Office Benchmark
events.summary: Sony Pictures Entertainment's "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" shattered box office records, earning $360 million domestically and an astounding $932 million globally during its opening weekend. This achievement marks the biggest domestic opening of all time and highlights the film's success in resonating with audiences worldwide through compelling storytelling and beloved characters. The movie's strong performance is attributed to the collaborative efforts of Sony Pictures' Motion Picture Group, the filmmaking team, and the cast, including star Tom Holland.

events.title: Press Release: The Walt Disney Company to Report Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Tomorrow
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company announced it will release its fiscal third quarter 2026 financial results on August 5, 2026. events.title: Mattel Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
events.summary: Mattel reported a 10% increase in Q2 2026 net sales, driven by strong growth in North America, vehicles, games, and action figures, while reaffirming its full-year outlook despite increased advertising and strategic investment costs. The company is actively working on a Barbie recovery plan with new content and product updates, and is expanding its digital gaming and film initiatives, including the successful Masters of the Universe movie. Although margins declined due to tariffs and inflation, Mattel anticipates improvement in the second half of 2026 and projects mid- to high-single-digit top-line growth for 2027.

events.title: FUBO CEO Teases November Strategy Reveal After Strong North America Subscriber Growth In Q3
events.summary: FuboTV CEO Alisa Bowen is set to unveil a broader growth strategy and shareholder value initiatives in November, following a strong third quarter with record North America paid subscribers. The company reported $1.482 billion in revenue and highlighted the success of its expanded relationship with Disney, including ESPN's "Where-to-Watch" integration and migration to Disney's advertising platform. Despite the positive subscriber growth, FUBO stock was down over 9% in pre-market trading, and 68% year-to-date.

events.title: Walt Disney Company & TikTok Ink Global Short-Form Content-Sharing Deal
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company and TikTok have announced a global content-sharing deal allowing creators and fans to use scenes from Disney movies and shows. This partnership will bring curated Disney-centric fan-created content from TikTok to the Disney+ app, with short-form videos from participating creators appearing on both platforms. The initiative aims to stimulate fan engagement, community building, and provide creators with a larger platform, especially after Disney's earlier generative AI partnership with OpenAI's Sora fell through.

events.title: Walt Disney Company & TikTok Ink Global Short-Form Content-Sharing Deal
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company and TikTok have announced a global content-sharing deal allowing creators to use Disney movie and show scenes. This collaboration will bring curated Disney-centric fan-created short-form content to both TikTok and the Disney+ app, starting with a US pilot. The initiative aims to stimulate fan engagement, provide creators with a platform, and build relationships with new creative talent.

events.title: Walt Disney Company & TikTok Ink Global Short-Form Content-Sharing Deal
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company and TikTok have announced a global deal allowing creators and fans to use scenes from Disney movies and shows, with a pilot launching in the US. This collaboration will bring curated Disney-centric fan content from TikTok to the Disney+ app, featuring characters and stories from brands like Pixar, Marvel, and Star Wars. events.title: The Walt Disney Company and TikTok Announce a First-of-its-Kind Global Short-Form Content-Sharing Deal
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company and TikTok have announced a global deal to bring fan-created short-form content from TikTok to the Disney+ app, starting with a US pilot. This collaboration will allow creators to use assets from Disney's extensive library, fostering fan engagement and potentially leading to more story discovery on Disney+. A jointly-run Creator Ambassador Program will also provide opportunities for emerging creative talent.

events.title: Disney Streaming Profit Doubles in June Quarter, Company Shifting Consumer Products to Studios Division
events.summary: Disney reported mixed Q3 2026 earnings, with streaming profits more than doubling and a strategic shift of most consumer products business from Disney Experiences to the entertainment unit. CEO Josh D’Amaro also highlighted the expansion of the AI tool J.A.R.V.I.S. for the Parks division and the success of "Toy Story 5," while also noting that "The Mandalorian and Grogu" and "Moana" underperformed at the box office. The company announced it will use proceeds from the A+E Global Media sale to increase share repurchases.

events.title: Walt Disney Co 2026: Revenue $25.25B, EPS $1.51— 10-Q Summary
events.summary: Walt Disney Co reported its Q2 2026 results with revenues of $25.25 billion and diluted EPS of $1.51, experiencing a 6.8% revenue increase but a significant decline in net income and EPS year-over-year. Revenue growth was driven by Services and Experiences, while the company noted increased capital spending for parks, new attractions, and cruise fleet expansion. Content investment remains elevated with approximately $24 billion expected for FY2026.

events.title: FuboTV Delivers $1.48 Billion Global Revenue in Q3 FY 2026, Record Q3 North America Subscribers
events.summary: FuboTV announced strong financial results for Q3 fiscal 2026, reporting $1.482 billion in global revenue and a record 5.75 million North America paid subscribers. The company achieved a net loss of $25.7 million and adjusted EBITDA of $19.1 million, while reaffirming its fiscal 2028 adjusted EBITDA target of at least $300 million. CEO Alisa Bowen highlighted strong subscriber acquisition during major sports events and improvements in the advertising business, with a focus on accelerating growth and enhancing user experience.

events.title: Walt Disney Company’s Q3 2026 Earnings Results
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company announced strong Q3 2026 earnings, with revenues increasing 7% to $25.2 billion and total segment operating income rising 21% to $5.6 billion. The growth was driven by its Experiences segment, particularly the launch of new Disney Cruise Line ships, the Disney Destiny and Disney Adventure, which significantly increased stateroom capacity. The company reiterated its full-year adjusted EPS growth outlook and plans for further share repurchases.

events.title: Earnings Flash (FUBO) FuboTV Posts Fiscal Q3 Revenue $1.48B, vs. FactSet Est of $1.5B
events.summary: FuboTV (FUBO) announced its fiscal Q3 revenue of $1.48 billion, falling short of FactSet's estimated $1.5 billion. This financial update follows previous reports of the company's Q3 2026 earnings call and a slight rise in shares after the financial results were released.

events.title: What Happens When Stock Implied Volatility Outpaces the SPY
events.summary: This article examines the historical performance of SPY options versus individual stock options when the implied volatility (IV) of individual stocks significantly outpaces that of the SPY. The author notes that this current situation, where individual stock IV is around 50% while SPY IV is 13.5%, is the highest spread since 2016. Historically, in such environments, SPY options, particularly straddles, have been underpriced and performed well, while individual stock options have struggled.

events.title: Disney Q3 FY26 Earnings: Commentary from CEO Josh D’Amaro
events.summary: Disney CEO Josh D’Amaro discussed the company's Q3 FY26 earnings, highlighting a unified strategy focused on creative excellence, technology leverage, and deepening fan relationships. He pointed to the success of franchises like Toy Story and growth in global guests and ESPN viewership as proof of this strategy's effectiveness. D'Amaro also outlined future plans for Disney Experiences, streaming evolution, sports engagement, and the strategic use of AI to enhance creativity and efficiency.

events.title: CONFIRMED: A BIG Restructuring Is Coming to the Walt Disney Company
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company is undergoing a significant restructuring, moving its Consumer Products Division from Disney Experiences to Disney Entertainment, specifically under Studios. This change aims to more closely align merchandise creation with the intellectual property teams, facilitating better collaboration. Lisa Baldzicki will continue as President of Disney Consumer Products during this transition.

events.title: Walt Disney Company Announces MAJOR Restructuring
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company is undertaking a major restructuring of its Consumer Products division, moving most of its business from Disney Experiences to Disney Entertainment Studios starting in October. This strategic shift aims to integrate consumer products more closely with creative and business teams to enhance franchise relevance and cohesion across the Disney ecosystem. The Consumer Products division, which licenses Disney IP to various companies, generated $63 billion in retail sales in 2025.

events.title: Disney theme park attendance grows, fueled by Toy Story 5 success and loyal fans, Josh D'Amaro says
events.summary: Disney's theme park attendance, encompassing Disney World and Disneyland, saw a 3% increase in the latest quarter, contributing to strong financial earnings for the company's Experiences division. This growth, highlighted by CEO Josh D'Amaro, occurred despite broader economic uncertainties and contrasts with declining attendance at competitor parks. D'Amaro attributed Disney's success to strong fan relationships and the synergistic "Disney flywheel" model, where intellectual properties like "Toy Story 5" (which generated significant box office and streaming numbers) drive engagement across movies, parks, cruises, and retail, leading to record-setting revenue and operating income.

events.title: Quarterly report: Disney says theme park attendance is up
events.summary: Walt Disney Co. announced an increase in theme park attendance and guest spending for its third financial quarter, bucking a trend of decline in Central Florida tourism. This growth was attributed to "Cool Kids Summer" promotions, re-opened attractions, and investments, particularly at Walt Disney World. The company emphasized that its performance significantly surpasses competitors like SeaWorld Orlando and Universal Orlando, which recently reported attendance dips.

events.summary: Ecovyst Inc. reported strong financial results for Q2 2026, with adjusted diluted earnings of $0.21 per share, exceeding analyst estimates, and revenue of $250.0M, a 42.0% increase year-over-year. Wall Street analysts maintain a largely positive outlook, with 7 buy ratings and 2 hold ratings.

events.summary: U.S. stocks saw significant gains on Wednesday, with the Dow Jones index climbing over 500 points, driven by strong performances in the healthcare sector. Walt Disney Co. reported better-than-expected fiscal third-quarter earnings, contributing to the market's positive sentiment. While several equities like Yxt.com Group and INLIF Ltd. surged, others such as Tigo Energy Inc. and China SXT Pharmaceuticals Inc. experienced sharp declines.

events.title: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. Reports Results for the Second Quarter of 2026
events.summary: Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. announced strong results for the second quarter of 2026, with comparable hotel RevPAR growing by 7.0% and comparable hotel Total RevPAR increasing by 5.9%. The company raised its full-year 2026 guidance for comparable hotel Total RevPAR and RevPAR growth ranges to 4.75% to 5.25%, driven by solid rate growth, robust leisure transient demand, and healthy group business, including benefits from the FIFA World Cup. These results underscore the effectiveness of their capital allocation strategy and the quality of their diversified portfolio, positioning them for long-term value creation.

events.summary: Sinclair, Inc. filed its unaudited quarterly report (Form 10-Q) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, revealing total liabilities of $5,177 million and an increase in issued Class A shares. The report details debt repurchases totaling $165 million in April and further repurchases in July, alongside the cancellation of $38 million in borrowing capacity. The company also addressed the Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing of Dish Network, stating it expects to collect amounts due in the ordinary course, but acknowledges potential uncertainties regarding recovery timing.

events.title: Fubo ad revenue drops to $108.9 million in its World Cup quarter
events.summary: FuboTV reported advertising revenue of $108.9 million for Q3 fiscal 2026, a slight decrease from the previous year, despite the FIFA World Cup 2026 generating three times the ad revenue of the 2022 tournament. The company attributed some improvements to the integration with the Disney Ad Server and optimized audience targeting. FuboTV also updated its fiscal 2026 Pro Forma Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $90 million to $100 million.

events.title: fuboTV Inc. Q3 2026 Earnings Call Summary
events.summary: fuboTV Inc. reported strong Q3 2026 results, attributing success to the Hulu + Live TV combination, the 2026 World Cup, and strategic advertising transitions to Disney's ad server. The company reaffirmed its target for positive free cash flow in fiscal 2027 and 2028, raising its fiscal 2026 pro forma adjusted EBITDA guidance. Key strategies include pricing optimization, content expansion, distribution partnerships, and AI-driven innovation, while maintaining Fubo and Hulu as distinct brands.

events.title: Ziff Davis (ZD) Reports Earnings Tomorrow: What To Expect
events.summary: Digital media company Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is scheduled to report its earnings after market close on Thursday. events.title: fuboTV Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
events.summary: fuboTV reported its Q3 2026 earnings, highlighting subscriber growth driven by World Cup programming and advertising integration with Disney. The company raised its fiscal 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance and expects positive free cash flow in fiscal 2027 and 2028.

events.title: eBay CEO Jamie Iannone’s new playbook embraces AI tools while blocking AI buyers
events.summary: eBay CEO Jamie Iannone is navigating the AI landscape by encouraging sellers to use its in-house AI tools for listings while banning third-party autonomous AI shopping agents from its platform. This strategy aims to amplify commissions and enhance customer experience, as evidenced by a 15% revenue increase and 51% net income growth in the second quarter. The company also recently finalized a $1.4 billion acquisition of Depop, focusing on used and refurbished items to differentiate from larger e-commerce competitors.

events.summary: Walt Disney Co. is considering launching a free, ad-supported streaming service to attract more viewers and enhance its advertising revenue, similar to platforms like Tubi and Pluto TV. This move aims to target price-sensitive consumers and potentially serve as a gateway to paid Disney+ subscriptions. The exploration was revealed during Disney's fiscal third-quarter 2026 earnings call, where the company also reported exceeding earnings estimates.

The pair pivoted from pursuing an NBA expansion team in Las Vegas to making an aggressive offer for the Lakers.

events.title: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
events.summary: Kraft Heinz reported its Q2 2026 earnings, showing a 1.4% decline in net sales and an 18.4% drop in adjusted operating income. Despite these declines, the company increased its 2026 investment plan by $100 million to $700 million, citing positive responses to increased marketing spend and aiming for improved market share and organic sales growth. Management provided updated guidance for 2026, expecting organic net sales to decline between 0.5% to 2.0%, and highlighted strategic focus on emerging markets, global foodservice channels, and specific brand innovations like PowerMac and a new partnership with Disney.

events.title: Procter & Gamble, Fubo, BHP & Banana Republic: People Moves
events.summary: This article details recent executive appointments at major companies. Shailesh G. Jejurikar has been promoted to CEO at Procter & Gamble, Alisa Bowen is the new CEO of Fubo, Donald Kohler takes the helm as CEO of Banana Republic, and Brandon Craig has been appointed CEO of BHP. These leadership changes aim to drive growth and strategic initiatives within their respective organizations.

events.title: Bath & Body Works Stock (BBWI) Falls as Nightmare Collection Tests a $48 Million Store-Sales Gap
events.summary: Bath & Body Works (BBWI) shares fell 3.65% after unveiling a "Nightmare Before Christmas" collection, raising concerns about its ability to reverse a $48 million first-quarter store sales decline. While the collection generated significant search interest, investors are questioning if seasonal buzz will translate into increased store traffic and revenue. The company's adjusted operating income and diluted EPS also declined, despite a reported profit increase boosted by a one-time settlement.

events.title: Insider Selling: Burke & Herbert Financial Services (NASDAQ:BHRB) Director Sells $109,545.00 in Stock
events.summary: Burke & Herbert Financial Services (NASDAQ:BHRB) Director James Mason Burke sold 1,500 shares of the company's stock for $109,545, retaining 258,480 shares valued at approximately $18.9 million. The company's shares rose 0.1% to $73.70 and are near their 52-week high. Analysts currently rate the stock as a "Moderate Buy" with an average price target of $75.25.

events.title: Insider Selling: A10 Networks (NYSE:ATEN) General Counsel Sells $392,435.96 in Stock
events.summary: A10 Networks' General Counsel, Robert Scott Weber, sold 14,086 shares of company stock for $392,435.96 on August 11th, reducing his direct ownership by 21.78%. This transaction occurred under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates with $0.25 EPS and $80.14 million in revenue, and announced a quarterly dividend.

events.title: Rep. Mike Kelly Sells Off Shares of PepsiCo, Inc. (NASDAQ:PEP)
events.summary: Representative Mike Kelly recently sold between $15,001 and $50,000 worth of PepsiCo shares from a trust account on July 17th, along with smaller positions in Abbott Laboratories and Walt Disney. Despite the sale, PepsiCo reported strong quarterly earnings, exceeding expectations with $2.20 EPS and $24.18 billion in revenue, and declared a quarterly dividend of $1.48 (4.3% annualized yield). Analysts generally maintain a "Hold" rating for PepsiCo, with an average price target of $157.90, higher than its current trading price of $138.70.

events.title: Merit Medical Systems Stock Climbs 25% On A 14-Day Winning Streak
events.summary: Merit Medical Systems (MMSI) stock has experienced a significant surge, climbing 25% over a 14-day winning streak, adding $1.1 billion to its market value. While this momentum is notable, the article advises investors to look beyond the streak and evaluate fundamental support, noting the company's above-median revenue growth but below-median operating margin and higher price-to-earnings multiple compared to the S&P 500 median. It emphasizes that streaks eventually end and encourages a disciplined approach to investment decisions based on thorough analysis rather than just market momentum.

events.title: Bill Ackman Takes Another Swing At NFLX After Colossal 2022 Loss: 'Netflix Has Effectively Won The Streaming Wars'
events.summary: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman, through Pershing Square, has acquired a new stake in Netflix (NFLX) after previously selling shares in 2022 for a $400 million loss. Pershing Square now believes Netflix has "effectively won the streaming wars" due to its dominant global platform, content discipline, strong cash flow, and an attractive valuation after a 50% drop from June 2025 highs. The firm expects Netflix to achieve double-digit revenue growth and nearly 20% annual earnings growth, driven by its ad-supported tier, password-sharing crackdown, and share buybacks.

events.title: Bill Ackman Takes Another Swing At NFLX After Colossal 2022 Loss: 'Netflix Has Effectively Won The Streaming Wars'
events.summary: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman, through Pershing Square Holdings Ltd., has reacquired a stake in Netflix (NFLX) after previously selling shares in 2022 for a significant loss. Pershing Square now believes Netflix has "effectively won the streaming wars" due to its dominant global platform, content discipline, strong cash flow, and an attractive valuation after a 50% stock decline from its June 2025 highs. The firm expects Netflix's revenue and earnings to continue growing, supported by its ad-supported tier, password-sharing crackdown, and AI-powered recommendations.

events.title: Oldfield Partners LLP Grows Holdings in The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: Oldfield Partners LLP significantly increased its stake in The Walt Disney Company by 47.9% in Q2, acquiring 241,700 additional shares, bringing its total to 745,800 shares valued at $71.8 million. Disney now constitutes 17.3% of Oldfield Partners' portfolio, making it their third-largest holding. The increased investment follows Disney's strong fiscal third quarter, which saw record Experiences revenue and adjusted EPS of $2.06, surpassing consensus estimates.

events.title: Playtika (PLTK) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
events.summary: Playtika reported Q2 2026 earnings with revenue up 5% year-over-year to $731.1 million and adjusted EBITDA increasing 23.4% to $206.1 million. The company strategically front-loaded marketing investments in Q1, leading to a planned step-down in spend and significant margin expansion in Q2. Despite a cautious outlook for the second half due to softening consumer sentiment and inflation, Playtika reiterated its full-year guidance, expecting to finish at the lower end of the ranges, emphasizing the long-term sustainability and profitability of its direct-to-consumer platform and titles like Disney Solitaire.

events.title: Netflix Stock Jumps 3.4% as Ackman Returns With New Stake
events.summary: Netflix stock rose by 3.4% after Bill Ackman's Pershing Square announced a new stake in the company. Ackman, who previously sold his Netflix holdings at a loss in 2022, is reinvesting after a significant stock decline, recognizing the company's improved financial strength, strong operating leverage, and growing advertising revenue. GuruFocus and Pershing's analysis suggest Netflix is undervalued despite potential risks, with strong earnings growth projected.

events.title: WATCH | Technical analysis of Sanlam, Airbus and Walt Disney Co
events.summary: Business Day TV features Craig Pheiffer, chief investment strategist at Otto1890, who provides a technical analysis of Sanlam, Airbus, and Walt Disney Co. The video delves into the financial prospects and market trends of these three major companies.

events.title: Sorcerer’s Apprentice Mickey Balloon Debuts for Macy’s 100th Parade
events.summary: Disney's Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey Mouse will debut as a new giant character balloon in the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. This marks a continuation of Disney's long history with the parade, which began in 1934 with the first Mickey Mouse balloon. To celebrate this milestone, Macy's is also launching an exclusive Disney capsule collection of merchandise inspired by the new balloon and the parade's centennial.

events.title: Disney x Macy's collection: Shop the top fashion, accessories and toys, inspired by the Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey balloon
events.summary: Macy's has launched an exclusive Disney Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey collection to celebrate Mickey's appearance as a giant balloon in the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. The collection features fashion, accessories, and collectibles from various brands, including Loungefly, Citizen, Crocs, and Swarovski. Items include headbands, bags, apparel, and a plush toy, all inspired by the iconic Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey.

events.title: How Games Are Helping Shape Disney’s Next Chapter
events.summary: Disney is increasingly leveraging original interactive games as a powerful storytelling medium and an entry point for new audiences to engage with its characters and franchises. Sean Shoptaw, EVP of Global Games and Digital Entertainment, highlights that games are moving beyond adaptations to create original narratives, contributing significantly to Disney's consumer spend. The company is also forming strategic partnerships, like with Epic Games, to build integrated entertainment universes where gaming, storytelling, and creator expression blend, reflecting how modern audiences consume content.

events.title: Disney and Formula 1® Extend Their Collaboration Through 2028 and Welcome Disney and Pixar’s Cars
events.summary: Disney and Formula 1 have extended their collaboration through 2028, now including Disney and Pixar's Cars characters. This expansion beyond Mickey & Friends will feature immersive experiences, engaging content, and new merchandise, with the "Cars Collection with Formula 1" debuting at D23 and online. The partnership aims to combine Disney's storytelling with racing fandom, building on past successful initiatives like the F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix 2025 and a Make-A-Wish auction.

events.title: What Is Fox (FOXA) Gaining From Its New Streaming Ad Partnership?
events.summary: Fox Corporation's Tubi Media Group has partnered with Gracenote to enhance content discovery and advertising on its streaming platforms, Tubi and FOX One. This collaboration aims to leverage metadata for sharper content recommendations and targeted advertising, aligning with Fox's strategy to bolster digital growth and monetize its streaming audience. The initiative is crucial for Fox as it seeks to offset traditional TV pressures and compete with other major media companies in the evolving streaming landscape.

events.title: IZEA Reports Q2 2026 Revenue of $5.8 million, Advances Enterprise-Focused Growth Strategy
events.summary: IZEA Worldwide, Inc. reported its Q2 2026 financial results, with revenue of $5.8 million, a 36% decrease year-over-year, primarily due to a strategic shift towards enterprise customers and market uncertainties. Despite a net loss of $0.7 million, the company maintained $46.6 million in cash and no long-term debt, and secured new business from major clients like Nestle and Amazon Studios. IZEA is advancing its enterprise-focused growth strategy, strengthening client relationships, and enhancing its ZED technology platform, anticipating a stronger second half of the year.

events.title: The Walt Disney Company, TikTok launch global deal to bring creator-made short-form content to Disney+
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company and TikTok have announced a global content-sharing deal to bring fan-created short-form videos from TikTok to Disney+. This partnership, initially piloting in the US, allows TikTok creators to use Disney's extensive library to make content, with selected videos appearing on both platforms. The initiative aims to deepen audience engagement with Disney's franchises and provide a larger platform for creators, including a Disney Creator Ambassador Program.

events.title: Comcast Corporation $CMCSA Shares Sold by Patriot Financial Group Insurance Agency LLC
events.summary: Patriot Financial Group Insurance Agency LLC significantly reduced its stake in Comcast Corporation (CMCSA) by 49.4% in the second quarter, selling over 135,000 shares. Despite this, Comcast holds a consensus "Hold" rating from analysts with an average price target of $32.96. The company recently exceeded earnings and revenue estimates and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.33 per share.

events.title: Disney Publishing Unveils Disney Cursed Love, an All-New Romantasy Series, Debuting Exclusively on WEBTOON in 2027
events.summary: Disney Publishing announced a new "romantasy" initiative called Disney Cursed Love at D23 2026, which will debut exclusively on WEBTOON in 2027. The series will launch with "The Curse of a Forsaken Heart" by Emily McIntire and Samairu, featuring Belle and the Beast in a new magical adventure. This builds on an existing collaboration between Disney, Marvel, and WEBTOON, bringing more Disney-inspired content to the platform.

events.title: Netflix leans into young adult dramas as YouTube threat grows
events.summary: Netflix is intensifying its focus on young adult (YA) dramas by launching a new hub for hundreds of coming-of-age series and films, having already accumulated over 10.5 billion views in this genre since 2023. This strategic move comes as the streaming giant faces increased competition from rivals like YouTube, which currently commands a larger share of TV streaming watch time. With new YA titles like “Sunshine Girls” and “The Body” on the horizon, Netflix aims to leverage the genre's popularity to boost engagement and maintain its leadership in content variety.

events.title: Power Rangers Reboot Falls at Disney+: Hasbro’s IP Deal Dooms Both Streaming Bids
events.summary: Disney+ has canceled its planned live-action Power Rangers series, following a similar decision by Netflix in 2024. The primary reason for both cancellations is the financial impracticality of major streaming platforms funding high-budget productions for intellectual property (IP) they do not own, as Hasbro holds the Power Rangers brand. This issue is compounded by the end of the Super Sentai footage pipeline from Japan, which historically made Power Rangers production more affordable, forcing any new series to bear full production costs.

events.title: An inside look at what's to come for The Walt Disney Company
events.summary: Joelle Garguilo provides a preview of the upcoming D23 event from Anaheim, offering insights into what's next for The Walt Disney Company. The article briefly mentions this preview as the main content.

events.title: Walt Disney Co. stock outperforms competitors on strong trading day
events.summary: Shares of Walt Disney Co. (DIS) rose 1.96% to $106.85 on Friday, outperforming the broader market which saw the S&P 500 Index and Dow Jones Industrial Average decline. This marks the second consecutive day of gains for Disney's stock.

events.title: Netflix plans to close two gaming studios, including one in Hollywood
events.summary: Netflix is closing two of its gaming studios, Night School in Hollywood and Moonloot in Helsinki, as part of an organizational restructuring to operate more efficiently. This move follows mixed results in its gaming strategy since expanding into the sector in 2021 and a previous studio shutdown last year. Despite these closures, co-CEO Greg Peters emphasized the significant market opportunity in gaming, noting solid numbers from cloud and kid games, even as Netflix faces investor pressure due to declining stock and lower streaming-watch time compared to rivals like YouTube.

events.title: Walt Disney Co SEC Filing (Aug 14, 2026)
events.summary: This article details a Form 144 SEC filing by Walt Disney Co (DIS) on August 14, 2026. The filing indicates a proposed sale of 7,238 shares of common stock with an aggregate market value of $762,198.18, acquired through the exercise of employee stock options. The transaction was a broker-assisted cashless exercise, with Merrill Lynch listed as the broker.

events.title: WEBTOON Entertainment Inc. Common stock Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary
events.summary: WEBTOON Entertainment Inc. reported a Q2 2026 net loss of $14.6 million due to higher income tax and marketing investments, but management is optimistic about returning to double-digit revenue growth by Q4 2026. The company is shifting its strategy towards direct ownership of IP adaptations and is investing in AI for interactive webcomics and auto-translation tools. Strategic initiatives include a $100 million IP adaptation fund with NAVER, an investment in Allied Games Holdings, and collaborations with Disney and Marvel to expand its English-language audience.

events.title: ‘Kingdom Hearts’ Greenlit for First-Ever Original TV Series on Disney Channel and Disney+
events.summary: Disney Channel and Disney+ have greenlit "Kingdom Hearts," an original anime series inspired by the popular video game franchise. Developed in partnership with Tetsuya Nomura and SQUARE ENIX, the series will offer a new story within the Kingdom Hearts universe. This announcement was made at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event, highlighting Disney's continued focus on animated content for families.

events.title: Why Spotify (SPOT) Is Up 5.1% After Strong Q2 2026 Results and Capital Return Update
events.summary: Spotify's stock (SPOT) rose 5.1% after reporting strong Q2 2026 results with €4.78 billion in revenue and €545 million in net income, and providing optimistic Q3 guidance. The company also completed a US$1.21 billion share repurchase program, demonstrating a balance between growth investments and returning capital to shareholders, supported by improving profitability and gross margins. This performance reinforces the investment narrative that Spotify can effectively monetize its large user base while managing content costs.

events.title: D23 2026: Disney Reveals What’s Next in Entertainment
events.summary: The D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event in Anaheim showcased upcoming projects from across Disney's various studios and platforms. CEO Josh D’Amaro highlighted Disney's global connection with over four billion fans, and the event featured exclusive first looks, celebrity appearances, and major announcements for films like "Lilo & Stitch 2", "The Bluey Movie", "Ice Age: Boiling Point", "Tangled", "Incredibles 3", "Coco 2", "Avengers: Doomsday", and new series such as "VisionQuest" and an untitled X-Men film. The event also revealed new animated series, theatrical group plans, and extensions of fan experiences like Mundo Pixar.

events.title: Magnite Targets CTV Growth With Walmart, Samsung Partnerships and AI Ad Tools
events.summary: Magnite is expanding its focus on connected-TV (CTV) advertising through strategic partnerships with major platforms like Walmart and Samsung, and by developing AI-driven ad tools. The company aims to be a key programmatic access point for CTV inventory, leveraging its relationships with large global partners and improving ad-serving technology. While the new Walmart and Samsung opportunities have not yet contributed revenue, Magnite anticipates future growth from these ventures and is also focused on optimizing its cost structure and improving EBITDA margins.

events.title: Madison Square Garden Hasn't Paid Property Taxes Since 1982. Now the Knicks Are Worth $11.75 Billion
events.summary: The article discusses the astronomical $11.75 billion valuation of the New York Knicks, driven by a recent championship, a massive national media deal, loosened private equity rules, and a perpetual property tax exemption for Madison Square Garden. It highlights how fan devotion translates into immense financial value for the franchise, while fans themselves have no leverage. The author, a Knicks fan, reflects on the implications of this valuation and the team's financial practices, including the lack of property tax payments by MSG since 1982.

events.title: Five Below's $5 Throwback Disney Channel Movie Tee Will Make You 'Strut Like You Mean It'
events.summary: Five Below has released a new $5.55 graphic tee featuring the original cast of Disney Channel's "The Cheetah Girls." This nostalgic merchandise targets early 2000s Disney Channel fans, especially given the movie's cultural impact. The article also mentions the upcoming "The Cheetah Girls: Next Gen" series, highlighting the continued relevance of the franchise.

events.title: Disney Experiences Showcase Reveals Major Park Updates at D23 2026
events.summary: The Disney Experiences Showcase at D23 2026 revealed significant park updates worldwide, including a reimagined Tomorrowland at Disneyland Park and a new Journey Into Imagination at EPCOT featuring Figment and Dreamfinder. Hosted by Neil Patrick Harris, the event also announced new attractions for Walt Disney World Resort, Disneyland Resort, and international parks, alongside a historic seventh season for Marvel's Spidey and His Amazing Friends. The showcase highlighted Disney's commitment to immersive storytelling and fan engagement, culminating in the anticipation of the Disney Legends Awards Ceremony.

events.title: Bellars Harris Wealth Management LLC Purchases New Position in BrightSpring Health Services, Inc. $BTSG
events.summary: Bellars Harris Wealth Management LLC has acquired a new stake in BrightSpring Health Services, Inc. (NASDAQ:BTSG) during the second quarter, purchasing 63,001 shares valued at approximately $4.394 million. Other institutional investors also bought new positions in the company. BrightSpring Health Services reported strong financial results, beating analyst estimates for earnings per share and revenue, and analysts widely recommend the stock with a "Buy" rating.

events.title: Disney Leaders Talk Streaming Strategy and Growth Drivers: Sports, Local Language, Vertical Media and Emerging Formats
events.summary: Disney executives at the D23 fan fest discussed their strategy for streaming growth, focusing on vertical media, global sports expansion through ESPN, and local-language content production. They emphasized engaging next-generation fans with short-form content, leveraging social media for promotion, and catering to both die-hard and casual sports fans. The company also highlighted its "local for local" content approach to reduce churn and appeal to diverse international audiences, particularly in Asia Pacific.

events.title: Disney Games Just Laid Out Its Vision for the Future of Digital Entertainment — Here’s What D23 Revealed
events.summary: At D23, Disney Games showcased its vision for the future of interactive entertainment, highlighted by announcements for KINGDOM HEARTS IV, Marvel’s Wolverine, and a new collaboration with Epic Games for Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run in Fortnite. Disney aims to use its games portfolio as a primary entry point for fans to engage with Disney stories and characters, working with world-class developers to create original content. The event also revealed an original Kingdom Hearts anime series and emphasized the connected digital experiences Disney is building.

events.summary: This page provides recent news and analysis for Starbucks Corp (SBUX) stock from TradingKey. It lists several past movements in SBUX's stock price, including significant increases and decreases, along with dates. The information is presented as a chronological feed of stock performance updates.

events.title: A Great Big Beautiful Tomorrow: Bob Iger Honored with a Window on Main Street, U.S.A.
events.summary: Former Disney CEO Bob Iger was honored with a personalized window on Main Street, U.S.A., at Disneyland Park, a tradition reserved for those who have significantly impacted the company. The window recognizes him as "Chief Architect for New Century Builders" and praises his leadership qualities like courage, innovation, and optimism. Disney CEO Josh D’Amaro lauded Iger for expanding Disney's storytelling, focusing on creativity, and inspiring employees through his vision and respect for the company's legacy.

events.title: Six Flags unveils largest-ever Halloween lineup with new haunted mazes and horror franchises for 2026.
events.summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation has announced its largest-ever Halloween event for 2026, featuring 11 new haunted mazes inspired by popular horror franchises such as Jason Universe™, Diablo®, Final Destination™, and The Blair Witch Project®. The event will include 29 licensed haunted attractions, 196 scare zones, live entertainment, and nighttime rides across its North American parks. This expanded offering aims to provide immersive horror experiences and thrills for all ages, with family-friendly daytime activities and flexible haunted maze passes also available.

events.title: How Bath & Body Works Captured the Spirit of Disney’s Jack Skellington and Sally Through Expertly Crafted Scent
events.summary: Bath & Body Works has launched a new limited-edition collection inspired by Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas, featuring two new fragrances: Jack Skellington and Sally. Developed in partnership with perfumers at DSM-Firmenich, these scents capture the essence of the characters through unique scent profiles like "pumpkin screams" for Jack and "ghastly blooms" for Sally. The collection includes body care, home fragrances, and accessories, available in Bath & Body Works stores and online.

events.title: SeaWorld offers Fun Card pass that covers rest of year, all of 2027
events.summary: SeaWorld Orlando is selling a Fun Card pass that provides admission to the theme park for the remainder of 2026 and all of 2027, priced at $139.99, with an option including Aquatica for $179.99. This limited-time offer, which includes some block-out dates and does not cover parking or separately ticketed events, comes ahead of a new attraction, Sea Quest: Legends of the Deep, and the announcement of SeaWorld's 2027 event schedule. Busch Gardens Tampa Bay is offering a similar Fun Card deal for $114.99.

events.title: Disney updates: Villains Land, Tropical Americas, Disco Yeti, more
events.summary: Walt Disney Co. has unveiled numerous attraction updates during the D23 fan event, detailing new rides and lands across its four Walt Disney World theme parks. Highlights include new names and story elements for the Tropical Americas section at Animal Kingdom, the announcement of "Villains Land" at Magic Kingdom with specific themed coasters, and new experiences for Hollywood Studios and Epcot. The company also confirmed the return of the Yeti animatronic in Expedition Everest and Dreamfinder at Epcot.

events.title: Spotify Just Crossed 300 Million Subscribers. Why Did the Stock Shrug?
events.summary: Spotify reported crossing 300 million paying subscribers, achieving record gross margins, and generating significant free cash flow in its latest quarter, yet its stock saw minimal reaction. Analysts are divided on Spotify's valuation, largely due to uncertainty surrounding its new revenue streams, such as premium monetization features and increased advertising effectiveness. The article suggests that the stock's future performance hinges on the success of these new initiatives and the company's ability to demonstrate controlled spending and margin expansion.

events.title: Life360 (LIF) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
events.summary: Life360 (LIF) reported strong Q2 2026 financial results, with total revenue growing 38% to $159 million and monthly active users reaching 102.4 million. The company is transitioning to an AI-native operating model, expanding its Family AI Lab, and shifting its hardware strategy towards bundled subscriptions, particularly for pets. Despite strong subscription revenue growth and advertising platform integration, full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance remains unchanged due to elevated seasonality in advertising and strategic investments.

events.title: JONAS BROTHERS BRING THE BURNING UP TOUR ALL OVER AGAIN TO MGM GRAND GARDEN ARENA NOVEMBER 28, 2026
events.summary: The Jonas Brothers announced "The Burning Up Tour All Over Again," a 45-city North American tour, after overwhelming demand for their Madison Square Garden shows. The tour, promoted by Live Nation, will stop at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas on November 28, 2026, with tickets going on sale August 21. This announcement follows a significant week for the band, including an NFL halftime performance announcement, the premiere of Camp Rock 3, and their induction as Disney Legends.

events.title: Disney (NYSE: DIS) finance EVP sells 7,238 shares in preset plan
events.summary: Brent Woodford, EVP, Control, Financial Planning & Tax at Walt Disney Co (DIS), sold 7,238 shares after exercising stock options on August 14, 2026, as part of a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1(c) trading plan. He exercised options at $105.21 per share and sold the shares at $105.31 per share. Following these transactions, Woodford directly holds 14,472 stock options and 62,323 common shares, with additional indirect holdings through his spouse's IRA and a 401(k) plan.

events.title: Buckland Partners Management Co LLC Takes $1.09 Million Position in The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: Buckland Partners Management Co LLC has acquired a new position in The Walt Disney Company, purchasing 11,223 shares valued at approximately $1.09 million during the second quarter. This move is part of broader institutional interest, with 65.71% of Disney's stock held by such investors. The company faces both opportunities, like theme park expansions and a strong entertainment pipeline, and challenges, including capital investment needs and potential "franchise fatigue" with its content slate.

Parker-Hannifin is highlighted for outperforming its industry with strong industrial demand and strategic acquisitions, despite risks in certain sectors and integration costs. events.title: Plato Investment Management Ltd Purchases Shares of 79,394 The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: Plato Investment Management Ltd recently acquired 79,394 shares of The Walt Disney Company, valued at approximately $7.6 million, marking a new position for the firm. This comes as institutional investors and hedge funds collectively hold a significant 65.71% of Disney's stock, and analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $128.61. Despite a recent revenue miss, Disney exceeded quarterly EPS expectations, with parks and streaming identified as key growth drivers.

events.title: Netflix Climbs 4% on Ackman’s Return, Still Down 16% in 2026
events.summary: Netflix shares rose 4% after Bill Ackman's Pershing Square disclosed a new position in the streaming company, four years after exiting a previous stake at a loss. Despite this gain, the stock remains down 16% year-to-date. The market viewed this as a Netflix-specific catalyst, as competing streaming services like Disney and Warner Bros. Discovery saw minimal movement.

events.title: Macy’s Kicks Off the 100-Day Countdown to the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade®
events.summary: Macy's is launching a 100-day countdown to its 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade, inviting customers to celebrate this centennial milestone. The parade will feature a record-breaking 100 inflatable elements, including new characters and the return of favorites like Underdog and Felix the Cat, alongside a new float honoring Tony Sarg. Macy's will also offer exclusive merchandise collaborations and educational partnerships with Khan Academy.

events.title: Disney and ABC sue FCC, seeking to stop early license renewal process
events.summary: The Walt Disney Co. and ABC have sued the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to prevent the early renewal of their broadcast licenses, arguing it's a retaliatory move by the Trump administration against ABC's content. The lawsuit claims the FCC's action is an attack on free speech and an "existential threat" to the company, stemming from criticism of ABC programs like "The View" and comments made by Jimmy Kimmel. Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro stated the company is committed to journalistic integrity and will not be dictated on how to run its broadcast business.

events.title: ABC and Disney sue FCC, alleging First Amendment violations
events.summary: ABC and its parent company Disney have filed a lawsuit against the Federal Communications Commission, accusing the Trump administration of violating their First Amendment rights. They allege that the FCC's investigations and challenges to broadcast licenses are retaliatory actions in response to ABC's news coverage, late-night satire, and talk show views. The lawsuit highlights President Trump's social media posts and past calls for ABC to lose its licenses, asserting that "Government censorship is deeply un-American."

events.title: Disney's D23: Everything announced, from rides to movies and more

events.title: InterDigital escalates UPC campaign against Disney over VP9 workaround

Despite a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts, some cautionary signals exist, including executive share sales and planned restructuring-related retirements.

events.title: The Walt Disney Company to Participate in the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference
events.summary: Hugh Johnston, Senior Executive Vice President & Chief Financial Officer of The Walt Disney Company, will participate in a question-and-answer session at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference. The event is scheduled for Wednesday, September 9, 2026, at approximately 2:30 p.m. ET/11:30 a.m. PT. Interested parties can stream the session live or access a recording afterward on Disney's investor relations website.

events.title: Walt Disney Co. stock underperforms Friday when compared to competitors despite daily gains
events.summary: Shares of Walt Disney Co. rallied 1.20% on Friday, closing at $108.10, despite an overall dismal trading session for the stock market. However, the stock still underperformed compared to its competitors. This rise ended a two-day losing streak for Disney's stock.

events.title: The Walt Disney Company (DIS)’s ABC Is Suing the FCC. A Judge Just Told it to Slow Down
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company's ABC network filed a First Amendment lawsuit against the FCC, claiming a "retaliatory campaign" due to President Trump's repeated calls for ABC to lose its licenses. A federal judge denied Disney's request for an urgent hearing, delaying a resolution and signaling a protracted legal battle. Despite strong company-wide earnings, the ongoing license review for ABC's stations creates uncertainty, with the judge's decision indicating the case will proceed on the court's timeline rather than Disney's preferred expedited schedule.

events.title: The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) Receives Consensus Recommendation of "Moderate Buy" from Brokerages
events.summary: The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has received a "Moderate Buy" consensus recommendation from twenty-one brokerages, with an average 12-month price target of $127.61, exceeding its current share price of $106.80. The company's latest quarterly results surpassed earnings expectations, driven largely by its Experiences segment, including parks and cruises. While institutional investors have increased their holdings, two executives recently sold shares under pre-arranged plans.

events.title: North Star Asset Management Inc. Makes New $15.41 Million Investment in The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: North Star Asset Management Inc. has initiated a new $15.41 million investment in The Walt Disney Company, acquiring 160,151 shares during the second quarter. This move aligns with a general trend among institutional investors, who collectively own 65.71% of Disney stock. The investment comes as Disney reported strong quarterly results, exceeding earnings expectations and showing revenue growth, despite some legal and reputational "noise" concerning a former actress's lawsuit.

events.title: ‘College GameDay’ at 40: Desmond Howard Reflects on the Magic Behind the ESPN Show
events.summary: Desmond Howard, a long-time analyst for ESPN's "College GameDay," reflects on the show's enduring success as it celebrates its 40th season and 500th road show. He credits the show's magic to the dedication of its entire team, both on-air and behind the scenes, and the passionate connection of figures like Lee Corso and Kirk Herbstreit to college football. Howard also shares his personal connection to the sport, from his Heisman Trophy win to his "I'm going to Disney World!" Super Bowl moment, highlighting how "College GameDay" continues to fuel fan excitement across the country.

events.title: Kahn Brothers Group Inc. Purchases Shares of 359,092 The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: Kahn Brothers Group Inc. has acquired 359,092 shares of The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) valued at approximately $34.6 million, making it their 18th-largest holding. Institutional investors now own 65.71% of Disney, which holds a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts with an average price target of $127.61. The company recently exceeded quarterly earnings expectations with $2.06 EPS against an estimated $1.86, and revenue increased by 6.8% year-over-year to $25.25 billion.

events.title: Old North State Trust LLC Buys New Stake in The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: Old North State Trust LLC has initiated a new stake in The Walt Disney Company, purchasing 4,729 shares valued at approximately $455,000 in the second quarter. This move aligns with a generally positive outlook from analysts, who have given Disney a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating and an average price target of $127.61, significantly above its recent share price of $106.80. Disney's strong Q2 performance, driven by its Experiences segment, and upcoming investments in resorts and cruise lines contribute to this positive sentiment, despite some minor legal and reputational concerns.

events.title: Exchange transition: Kraft Heinz departs Nasdaq for a new home on the NYSE
events.summary: Kraft Heinz (KHC) announced its decision to move its stock listing from Nasdaq to the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). The company expects trading on the NYSE to commence on September 14. This transition marks a significant change in the listing venue for the major food company.

events.title: Netflix Stock Price Prediction: The Road Back to $100
events.summary: Netflix shares have dropped by a third over the past year, but 24/7 Wall St. predicts a 26.6% upside to $101 within 12 months, assigning a "buy" recommendation with high confidence. This optimistic outlook is driven by Netflix's rapidly growing ad business, projected to double to $3 billion in 2026, and a record $4.7 billion stock buyback in Q2, with substantial authorization remaining. The company's strong operating margin of 33.4% also supports the target, outperforming competitors like Disney.

events.title: Apple implements price hikes for its TV streaming service and 'One' subscription bundle
events.summary: Apple has increased the prices for its Apple TV streaming service and its Apple One subscription bundle. Apple TV's monthly cost has risen from $12.99 to $14.99, while the Apple One individual plan is now $21.95, up from $19.95. This move follows similar price adjustments by other major streaming platforms and comes after Apple reported a record June quarter with $109.4 billion in revenue.

events.title: The Walt Disney Company Stock (DIS) Opinions on Q3 Earnings Beat and Box Office Performance
events.summary: The article discusses the mixed opinions surrounding The Walt Disney Company (DIS) following its Q3 earnings beat. While analysts acknowledge strong streaming subscriber growth and cost-cutting, concerns persist regarding the traditional linear TV business and box office underperformance, leading to varied stock outlooks.

events.title: AMC Entertainment (AMC) Q1 2026 Earnings: Results, Market Reaction & History
events.summary: AMC Entertainment reported a mixed Q1 2026, with revenue beating estimates at $1.05 billion, a 21.2% year-over-year gain, driven by a strong North American box office. However, the company's loss per share of $0.36 missed analyst expectations. Despite continued net losses, adjusted EBITDA turned positive, and management projects significantly rising revenues for full-year 2026 due to a robust film slate and new initiatives.

events.title: Apple TV raises prices without offering an ad tier, testing how much viewers will pay
events.summary: Apple TV has increased its subscription prices for the fourth time in four years, with monthly plans now costing $14.99 and annual plans $119.99. Unlike many competitors, Apple TV does not offer a cheaper, ad-supported tier. This move positions Apple TV as the latest streamer to raise prices, following companies like Netflix, Peacock, ESPN, Amazon Prime Video, and YouTube Premium, as the industry aims to offset rising programming costs.

events.title: Archer Investment Corp Acquires New Holdings in The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: Archer Investment Corp recently acquired a new stake in The Walt Disney Company, purchasing 15,912 shares valued at approximately $1.53 million. This move is part of a broader trend of institutional investors increasing their holdings, with analysts maintaining a "Moderate Buy" rating and a target price of $127.61. Despite some insider selling, Disney's recent financial performance, driven by strong adjusted EPS and revenue growth, along with optimism around streaming profitability and theme park expansion, continues to attract investor confidence.

events.title: New Mexico Educational Retirement Board Acquires 5,600 Shares of The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: The New Mexico Educational Retirement Board increased its stake in The Walt Disney Company by 6.8%, purchasing an additional 5,600 shares, bringing its total to 88,155 shares valued at approximately $8.5 million. Institutional investors collectively own 65.71% of Disney, and analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $127.61. The company recently reported adjusted earnings of $2.06 per share and 6.8% year-over-year revenue growth.

events.title: Livforsakringsbolaget Skandia Omsesidigt Makes New Investment in The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: Livforsakringsbolaget Skandia Omsesidigt has acquired a new stake in The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS), purchasing 12,304 shares valued at approximately $1.19 million in the second quarter. Institutional investors now own 65.71% of Disney's stock, with analysts maintaining a "Moderate Buy" rating and a consensus price target of $127.61. The company recently exceeded earnings expectations, reporting $2.06 per share against an estimate of $1.86, and revenue increased by 6.8% year over year to $25.25 billion.

events.title: Cullinan Associates Inc. Sells 5,715 Shares of The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: Cullinan Associates Inc. reduced its stake in The Walt Disney Company by 6.9% in the second quarter, selling 5,715 shares but still retaining 77,267 shares valued at $7.44 million. Despite this sale, institutional investors collectively own 65.71% of Disney, with several major firms increasing or initiating positions. Disney also surpassed quarterly earnings expectations and maintains a "Moderate Buy" rating from analysts with an average price target of $127.61.

events.title: Bank of New York Mellon Corp Acquires Shares of 1,685,407 Mattel, Inc. $MAT
events.summary: Bank of New York Mellon Corp has acquired a new stake of 1,685,407 shares in Mattel, Inc., valued at approximately $23.4 million, representing 0.58% of the company. Institutional investors collectively own 97.15% of Mattel, while analyst sentiment is mixed with a "Hold" rating and an average price target of $17.80. The company's latest quarterly revenue exceeded expectations, though adjusted earnings per share missed estimates.

events.title: Can Fluence Energy (NASDAQ:FLNC) Make Grid Storage the Next Small-Cap Story?
events.summary: Fluence Energy (NASDAQ:FLNC), a specialist in grid-scale battery storage, is attracting attention as the energy market prioritizes electricity reliability, renewable integration, and infrastructure resilience. The company's focused approach to energy storage, grid software, and long-term services positions it to benefit from growing demand driven by renewable energy expansion, increased electricity consumption from data centers, and the need for grid modernization. While the company faces intensifying competition and challenges with battery costs and supply chain stability, its role in enabling flexible and dependable electricity infrastructure in a rapidly evolving energy landscape suggests potential for significant growth.

events.title: What Changed for Franklin Financial (NASDAQ:FRAF) on Nasdaq Composite?
events.summary: Franklin Financial Services (NASDAQ:FRAF) operates as a bank holding company, F&M Trust, providing banking and wealth management services across Pennsylvania and Maryland. Despite its regional banking focus, distinct from typical Nasdaq tech companies, its stock trades on the Nasdaq. Recent quarterly results show increased earnings per share, net interest income, and assets, though nonperforming loans also rose due to commercial real estate exposure.

events.title: YRF elevates Hemant Kundnani to head of marketing
events.summary: Yash Raj Films (YRF) has promoted Hemant Kundnani to head of marketing, where he will lead the studio’s marketing strategy across its film and entertainment businesses in India and international markets. Kundnani, who has over 15 years of experience in digital strategy, content marketing, and strategic alliances, previously held leadership roles at The Walt Disney Company. Akshaye Widhani, CEO of YRF, expressed confidence in Kundnani's ability to bring a strategic and audience-first approach to marketing.

events.title: Save 50% on Disney+ and Hulu bundle with new student discount
events.summary: College students can now get a 50% discount on the Disney+ and Hulu basic (with ads) bundle, bringing the price down to $6.49 per month. This new student offer allows access to a wide range of content from Disney, Pixar, Star Wars, Marvel, as well as FX shows and ABC series on Hulu. Students need to verify their status to take advantage of this ongoing deal.

events.title: Walt Disney World Railroad Closing for Month-Long Refurbishment in Fall 2026
events.summary: The Walt Disney World Railroad is scheduled for a month-long refurbishment from September 28 to October 29, 2026, primarily for routine track maintenance. This closure is not related to the refurbishment of Tiana's Bayou Adventure, but it will happen while the railroad is operating in "shuttle mode" due to ongoing construction for Piston Peak National Park and Villains Land. The article discusses the history of WDW Railroad closures and speculates on why Disney chose to keep it partially operational this time.

events.title: Disney hit with discrimination lawsuit over alleged ‘I don’t trust Black people’ remark
events.summary: A Black former employee, William Lacks, has filed a lawsuit against The Walt Disney Co. and Capgemini America Inc., alleging racial discrimination, harassment, and wrongful termination. Lacks claims his Latino IT team leader made inappropriate remarks about Black people, favored employees of his own race, and subjected him to a hostile work environment. He seeks unspecified compensatory and punitive damages.

events.title: What is lifting Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) shares toward record highs?
events.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) shares are trading near record highs, driven by a series of drug approvals, strong pipeline momentum in oncology and immunology, and its diversified healthcare model. The company's financial strength, consistent dividend payments, and bluechip standing provide stability and investor confidence in a defensive sector. J&J's focus on innovative medicines and medical technology, coupled with sustained R&D spending and global healthcare demand, underpins its continued growth and resilience.

events.title: Disney (NYSE: DIS) exec exercises options at $105.21, sells at $107.13
events.summary: Brent Woodford, EVP, Control, Financial Planning & Tax at Walt Disney Co (DIS), exercised 3,618 stock options at $105.21 per share and simultaneously sold these 3,618 shares at $107.13 per share on September 1, 2026. This transaction was conducted under a Rule 10b5-1(c) trading plan adopted in February 2026. Following the sale, Woodford retains significant holdings in Disney stock options and shares through direct and indirect ownership.

events.title: 11 Forgotten Books Every ’90s Kid Loved Growing Up
events.summary: This article looks back at 11 popular children's book series from the 1990s that, despite their initial success and presence at Scholastic book fairs, are now largely out of print or forgotten. It covers titles like Animorphs, Give Yourself Goosebumps, Sweet Valley Twins, and Dear America, highlighting their unique premises, publication history, and eventual decline in popularity. The author emphasizes how these books were once integral to the reading experience of '90s kids.

events.title: The Buzziest New Show on Netflix? A Video Game Trailer
events.summary: Netflix recently experienced a massive, worldwide viewership event that caused tech issues and topped its charts, not with a movie or TV show, but with an exclusive "extended look" trailer for the highly anticipated video game, Grand Theft Auto VI. This phenomenon highlights a growing trend among streaming platforms like Disney and Amazon Prime Video to diversify content beyond traditional film and television, incorporating elements like TikToks, mobile-first video, and video games to drive engagement and cater to evolving consumer preferences. The article suggests that as entertainment lines blur, streaming services are increasingly exploring ancillary opportunities to capture consumer attention.
